title: Measuring Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment at the Scale of a Program Portfolio
abstract: arXiv:2608.12356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A college offering several overlapping computing degrees implicitly assumes that its programs are differentiated in line with how the labor market segments computing work and that, together, they prepare graduates for that market. Testing this is difficult, because the instruments available to curriculum committees, namely advisory boards, tracer studies, and employer surveys, are slow, narrow, and hard to reproduce. We apply one uniform, taxonomy-anchored alignment analysis across all five undergraduate programs of a College of Information Technology, comparing 1,922 course learning outcomes against 103,349 competencies extracted from a unified corpus of 5,186 deduplicated job openings from four boards. translated_title: 在项目组合规模上衡量课程与劳动力市场的对齐程度
translated_abstract: 一所学院提供多个重叠的计算相关学位，其隐含假设是这些项目在细分上与劳动力市场对计算工作的划分方式一致，并且它们共同为毕业生进入该市场做好准备。测试这一假设很困难，因为课程委员会可用的工具，即咨询委员会、追踪研究和雇主调查，速度慢、范围窄且难以复现。我们对一所信息技术学院的五个本科项目应用了统一的、基于分类学的对齐分析，将1,922个课程学习成果与从四个招聘板的5,186个去重职位公告的统一语料库中提取的103,349项能力进行比较。每项能力通过一个基于单一语言模型的程序获得，该程序逐字从来源复制并验证，然后将其分配到十一个与ESCO对齐的领域和一个布鲁姆认知水平；最终...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于分类学的统一方法，在项目组合规模上大规模比较课程学习成果与劳动力市场需求，以可复现的方式衡量课程与就业市场的对齐程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a taxonomy-anchored, uniform method to compare course learning outcomes against labor market competencies at scale, enabling reproducible measurement of curriculum-market alignment across a program portfolio.
